scope: Own readiness controller for exact archived HOST-scoped provisioning input and issuance mechanism. No creator edit, execution of candidate, DB, network, acceptance, activation or observer promotion.
oracle_before_candidate: Previously derived independent normative baseline, frozen common source/observation/separation contracts, existing native construction order and HOST root assumption, then actual current grant and v5 issuance evidence. Full source byte bindings retained.
authority_inference: Prospective project technical delegation plus existing HOST bootstrap role permits a bounded local policy provisioning decision through the actual managed HOST path. This is a technical provisioning choice; no evidence shows a necessary new CEO value choice or new external signing authority for this preparation route.

Existing HOST external trusted OS/service-manager is an explicit assumption. Actual manager launch/container/custodian birth control binds the observed operation to that path. Neither a grant SHA nor Docker access nor UID independently authenticates semantic authority.

The mandate does not make pending decision bytes approved policy. Parent/user delegation authorizes this separate verifier to perform applicable qualification and a distinct source-acceptance gate, without creator self-certification. No extra verifier-versus-acceptor inequality was invented.

Existing five-field accepted-root requirement applies before observer use. A prospective candidate must first be qualified then distinctly accepted under that root; requiring its own already-positive acceptance before qualification would prevent the authorized prospective route.
qualified_bounded_findings: Own reconstruction independently recomputed all172 typed control bytes and complete528 private bytes: SHA289874cf90923aa13f9f3a8a433a2eac8a69de20a5de446e200e3c27d49a086a. It checks parent/proposal references, manager/image/container refs, actual process birth/namespaces, whole record projection and ordered original/held intervals.

Source code has actual sender credentials/pidfd liveness, readonly sealed descriptor validation and exact full request/projection checks. These are bounded lineage/custody claims for this preparation flow, not acceptance or universal code/effect qualification.

This evidence can support a distinct acceptance decision for the exact archived issued-pending record AS PENDING DATA. That decision would accept the provenance and content of a pending decision, not approve1second, policy eligibility, future mechanism releases or E2.

No concrete need for an additional external authority was demonstrated for a fresh bounded existing HOST decision under the current grant. The missing positive scoped policy disposition/control is implementable through the already observed route, subject to independent review; not a global hard stop.
correction_to_prior_review: Earlier references to missing generation/barrier/current activation must be read as downstream operative-use limits, not blockers to qualification/acceptance of provisioning inputs. Construction_order explicitly places approved manifests first. Existing HOST root assumption and current delegation must be applied instead of demanding a new root from metadata.

smallest_existing_procedure.action: Distinct independent acceptance review may bind this exact reconstructed archived pending record, all5field provenance references, current governing rule versions and explicit pending-only subject. No operational observer input claim follows.

For substantive observation policy input, use existing managed HOST/custodian route for an explicit scoped positive/negative/deferred decision over exact version, numeric values, rule universe and context/use conditions. Current grant covers bounded technical choice; no new authority/key/service. Preserve this pending archive; fresh context requires fresh issuance, never replay/rebind old context.

Independently validate actual positive decision, qualified issuer leg, complete applicable scope/rules, finite checked bounds, same BOOTTIME basis, raw context/provenance and integrity. Values need an explicit governed decision, not an invented historical TTL formula or latency-based approval.

Only after applicable qualification genuinely holds, record separate exact5field source acceptance with issuer, subject/version/bytes/rule universe, qualification lineage and narrow permitted consumers. Preserve pending states where any mandatory input is missing.
Then construct generation/bootstrap/process/enrollment and applicable current barrier/activation/revocation before use, following frozen order. No operative authority inherited from input acceptance.

limits: Historical captured data only; container/custodian exited. No renewal, currentness restoration or future rebinding.
Request commits container/custodian identity, not a separately precommitted digest of every PG raw fact; final issued private record joins raw context.
No full source mechanism/effect closure, accepted root replacement, source acceptance, observer establishment or native/threat counter changes.
Partial proposed policy cannot silently be substituted for full E2 rule universe.
external_blocker: None demonstrated for the next bounded technical decision/control engineering step. Any future external claim must identify a specific governing predicate and missing authority, not infer absence globally.
validations: Own offline reconstruct.py rerun against unchanged pinned v5 inputs
Controller fail-closed decisions and mutation cases recorded separately
Source hashes verified before and after own work
next: Run the distinct narrow acceptance review for pending data if useful; engineer explicit actual policy disposition through the existing HOST path for substantive policy-input qualification. No activation prerequisite cycle.
controller_boundary: controller.py checks pinned bytes/reconstruction and explicit reviewer-assessed field statuses. It does not infer authority from nonnull strings and cannot create SOURCE_ACCEPTANCE_RECORD, approve values or activate policy. Manual normative assessment is in field-matrix/report, not replaced by test outputs.
acceptance_record_minimum: Exact source identity/type/scope; existing qualified authority/delegation and HOST assumption; captured provenance/control/context; separate independent qualification lineage and disposition; original source bytes/integrity; explicit pending-only versus approved-policy scope, permitted consumers and no-rebind/no-activation limits. This is an evidence checklist, not a new normative record schema or authority.
